stories.title: Rare bush dog pups emerge at Chester Zoo after 65-day pregnancy
stories.summary: Five bush dog pups have come out of their den at Chester Zoo for the first time, and the zoo says they are the only ones born in the UK this year. stories.title: Road safety groups press UK Government on alcohol interlocks for repeat drink-drive offenders
stories.summary: Police chiefs, police and crime commissioners and the RAC have asked the Prime Minister to give courts the power to stop convicted drink-drivers starting their cars. stories.title: Former police officer turned Flintshire MS opposes handing control of policing to Welsh Government
stories.summary: A Flintshire based politician who served with North Wales Police has rejected the case for handing control of policing to the Welsh Government, after the region’s police and crime commissioner cautiously backed the idea. stories.title: The TikTok approach parents in Flintshire are being told to warn their children about
